Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Vehicle Switch ON Normal conditions, HV in catenary
Test steps are independent of  cabine. 
Test must be repeated from both cabins.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Vehicle Switch ON Normal conditions, HV in catenary
Test steps are independent of  cabine. 
Test must be repeated from both cabins.
initial_conditions: - "PREVIOUS OF LOADS" Battery vehicle Line (Pot. 500 and 510) energized.
- Battery contactors open in both battery auxiliary boxes.
-Both "CAB KEYS" and  "DRIVING MODE SELECTOR" of "CAB ACTIVE KEY SWITCH/DIRECTION SELECTOR PANEL" (10A01) "0" position.

test_actions.text: Check in the cabin that it is possible to switch OFF/ON the cabin lights via the pushbutton 72S01
Check in the cabin that hazard lights can be switche ON/OFF via teh Hazard light switch 76S01
Check that Z6 light is available in cabin C1, by activating 76S02 switch
Exterior right Red lamp is switched ON

In CABIN
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 0 to 1

In CABIN
- Move direction selector 10A01 from 0 to 1 position
Measure time since command vehicle ON, and HMI start up.
Once HMI starts, check pantogarph symbol indicates pantograph is down
Measure time since command vehicle ON, and TCMS start up.
Check not faulty message from Fire Detection System or Event Recorder are showed
Battery Voltage is showed in the HMI
Pantograph symbol dissapears from the HMI
HV catenary value is showed in the HMI
Check Internal displays start up after the pantograph is up.
TCMS will menage the Test in the following systems
HVAC system, the system performs the autotest during the startup and provides the results to TCMS as alarms
Brake system, see functional description XXX
Check that Propulsion Main Contactors are closed.

IN active CABIN
Move direction selector to "1"
Check that Propulsion Main Contactors are opened.

Prior pantograph is lowered
-Check that HVAC units are stoopped.
-Compressor is stopped
-APS is stopped
Once auxiliary loads are stopped, the pantograph will be lowered.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Vehicle Switch OFF forced  from HMI
Test procedure demonstrates the process to inmediate switch OFF the vehicle.
Test steps are independent of  cabine. 
Test must be repeated from both cabins.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Vehicle Switch OFF forced  from HMI
Test procedure demonstrates the process to inmediate switch OFF the vehicle.
Test steps are independent of  cabine. 
Test must be repeated from both cabins.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN
- Move direction selector from V to 0 position

In Active CABIN
Deactive the cabin, moving to 0 position.
At HMI, PB  to force the battery disconection is Active.
Press the pushbutton to disconnect the battery.
Pushbutton Starts Flashing to indicate vehicle will be inmediatelly disconnected
Doors are commanded to be closed
Interior lighting is switched to dimmed level
Once battery disconnection sequence finish vehicle is switched OFF

Check that following systems are mantained ON for 30 minutes since the battery is switched OFF.
IVU Box panel (83A02 in C1 car
OBU rack (83A01) in C2 car
Ivanto Router(80A10) in C2 car
Confort Network 2(88A02) in C2 car
Radio Rack (80A01) in C2 car
Automatic Person Counter system (97A05) in C2 car

CONFORT NETWORK CAR SWITCH 2 switched OFF

vehicle Switch OFF, waiting time to switch off the vehicle after cab disabled

Test_Cases.description:

vehicle Switch OFF, waiting time to switch off the vehicle after cab disabled

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN
- Move direction selector from V to 0 position
- Move 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 1 to 0

Go to Tail cabine and:
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 0 to 1
- Move direction selector from 0 to V position

Check availabilty of hazard lights in non active cabin
Check availability of pantograph down command in non active cabin
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE

Check availability of pantograph down command in non active cabin

test_actions.text:
In TAIL CABIN
- Active 76S01 Hazzard/warning light PB

In TAIL CABIN
- Deactive 76S01 Hazzard/warning light PB

In TAIL CABIN
- Active 12S02 PB; DOWNLOAD PANTOGRAPH PUSHBUTTON

AC + TCUs load shutdown order 
-> 1s , APS shutdown order
-> 2s , Pantograph is lowered

Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
BATTERY ISOLATION

test_actions.text:
In  C2 car
Actuate 07S02 Push Button

Vehicle WILL SWITCH OFF immediately
Main Battery Circuit Breaker is dosconneted (07Q01)

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Test procedure demonstrates the process to switch on the vehicle from cleaning mode when the vehicle is switched off.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Test procedure demonstrates the process to switch on the vehicle from cleaning mode when the vehicle is switched off.

test_actions.text: Enable the Cleaning mode by pressing cleaning PB 10S20
Right side doors are released, but stays closed.
LEFT and RIGHT HMI will be OFF
Command to open single door via the exterior open pushnutton
Command again pushbutton to close the door
In the cabin, Move 10A01 direction switch to position 1
CLEANING mode is disabled and the mode "CAB CHANGE" is set up as there is not cab Active in the vehicle
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking) and vehicle switch off
Internal lights switch to EMERGENCY MODE
In this situation, press again cleaning PB 10S20
Place 10A01 direction switch in position 0 and  press again cleaning PB 10S20
Cleaning mode will be ON and push button lamp will be ON
5 minutes after, press again cleaning PB 10S20
Cleaning mode active time has been reactivated from the beginning
In the cabin, Move 10A01 direction switch to position 1
CLEANING mode is destroyed and the mode "CAB CHANGE" is set up as there is not cab Active in the vehicle
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking) and vehicle switch off
Internal lights switch to EMERGENCY MODE
Cleaning mode will be ON and push button lamp will be ON
Let passing the time 30mins, and before the end of the cleaning mode (elapsed time)
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking)

Test_Cases.description:

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN
- Move direction selector from 1 to 0 position

In Active CABIN
At HMI, PB  to force the battery disconection is Active.
Press the pushbutton to disconnect the battery.
Deactive the cabin, moving to 0 position cab active key
During the first 10 seconds of disconnections proccess, enable the Cleaning mode by pressing cleaning PB 10S20

Battery disconnection proccess is stopped.
Cleaning Mode operation starts
Right side doors are released, but stays closed.
LEFT and RIGHT HMI will be OFF
In the cabin, Move 10A01 direction switch to position 1
CLEANING mode is disabled and the mode "CAB CHANGE" is set up as there is not cab Active in the vehicle

Test_Cases.description:

test_actions.text: In the cabin, enable the maintenance mode by 10S10 MAINTENANCE MODE KEY
The functions activated in this mode will be the following
Maintenance alarms will be showed in the display
Coupler cover can be commanded separately from the couple unfolding and folding manoeuvre
Alarms will be marked as Maintenance mode
Press HVAC car C1 OFF pushbutton
Press HVAC car C2 OFF pushbutton
Enable HVAC car C1 and C2 back again
HVAC car C1 and C2 start operation
Press APS car C1 Disable Pushbutton
APS in car C1 is  disabled
Enable back again APS in car C1
Press APS car C2 Disable Pushbutton

APS in car C2 is  disabled
Battery supervision sequence will be active.
Enable back again APS in car C2
ED Brake will be disabled in TCU
Enable ED braking and disable regenerative braking
Regenerative braking is disabled in TCU
Regenerative braking is Active in TCU
Press TCU car C1 Disable Pushbutton
Press TCU car C1 Enable Pushbutton
Press TCU car C2 Disable Pushbutton
Press TCU car C2 Enable Pushbutton
Press the HMI languaje setting to change between German and English
Check that the HMI languaje changes between both.
In the cabin, disable the maintenance mode by deactiviting 10S10 MAINTENANCE MODE KEY

Check pantograph alarms
Test_Cases.description:

Check pantograph alarms

Disconnect cable 12152.01 from terminal A1 of contactor 12K01 (simulate failure of the contactor).
Command to raise the pantograph

test_actions.text: Simulate vehicle is at speed, via the Event recorder system
Simulate vehicle is standstill, via the Event recorder system
Disconnect cable 51121.02 from pin 09 of relay 18K02 in car C1
Reconnect cable 51121.02 from pin 09 of relay 18K02 in car C1
Disconnect cable 51121.02 from pin 07 of relay 18K03 in car C1
Reconnect cable 51121.02 from pin 07 of relay 18K03 in car C1

Close all the doors.
Simulate vehicle in speed

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test Case
Check the functionalities related with the TCMS degraded mode.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test Case
Check the functionalities related with the TCMS degraded mode.

test_actions.text:
Switch ON Vehicle
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 0 to 1
- Move direction selector 10A01 from 0 to 1 position
Enable TCMS degraded mode by 16S01 bypass switch

Activate Safety Brake by pressig the Emergency Brake mushroom
Enable TCMS degraded mode via 16S01 Bypass switch

TCMS degraded mode  is active.
Left HMI show indication "TCMS Degraded Mode"
Reelay 16K01 is active in car C1 and C2.
60 seg. After, Passengers HVAC will switch on
60 seg. After, Cab HVAC will switch on
Windscreen wiper starts slow speed in Active cabin
Curtains get up in both cabins

Propulsion Active O_PROP_ENAB=1
Messure 24Vdc in terminal XT14.113 terminal 22a
Passenger area lights will switch on at dimmer level in C1 and C2 cars
Windows demister will switch on at Active cabin.
11K20 contactor will connect in C1 and C2 cars
Deactivate Safety Braking releasing the emergency mushroom
Move direction selector 10A01 from 1 to V position

In car with cab active relay 16K10 is energized
In car with not cab active relay 16K11 is energized
Enable right  doors by HMI's virtual buttons
Actuate on 54S01 doors loop bypass to close all doors
All doors will disabled and closed
Enable left  doors by HMI's virtual buttons
Actuate on 54S01 doors loop bypass to close all doors
All doors will disabled and closed

Brake is applied
Brake tail-lights will illuminate

Forward sanders will active in car with cab Active
Backward sanders will activate in car with cab not Active
Move MC to mid propulsion position
Vehicle start movement at low speed.

Disable the cabin
- Move direction selector 10A01 from V to 0 position
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 1 to 0
After 2 minutes the battery is OFF

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test
Check the monitoring of the HV exterior socket by TCMS. 
Check that it is not possible to raise pantograph if  HV socket is connected.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test
Check the monitoring of the HV exterior socket by TCMS. 
Check that it is not possible to raise pantograph if  HV socket is connected.
initial_conditions: -Necessary to climb to the vehicle roof to perform the simulation
-HV 01X01 external socket located on the roof of the vehicle connected to pantograph.

test_actions.text: Disconnect the connector XC14.114 in the roof of car C1
The HV external socket connection status will be showed in the lower status indicator icon line in the HMI

Active on of the cabins.
Command to raise pantograph from the cabin

Remove link between pins 01 and 53
Reconnect the connector XC14.114 in the roof of car C1
The HV external socket connection status dissapears from the lower status indicator icon line in the HMI

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test
Check that the battery is charged correctly from APS in C1, in the event of failure of the APS in C2.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test
Check that the battery is charged correctly from APS in C1, in the event of failure of the APS in C2.

test_actions.text: Connect external device to TCMS system and simulate the failure of APS in C2 by forcing the variable APS_C2_BCG_STS.BCGShutDown = 1
Inside the battery housing in C2 check that relay 14K01 is energized.
Check that the battery is being charged. Verify that current flows through the battery.
Normalize the state of  APS in C2 unforcing variable APS_C2_BCG_STS.BCGShutDown.
Inside the battery housing in C2 check that relay 14K01 is de-energized.
